final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration about new GC Handle mechanisms in .NET 9 and .NET 10. The reader should quickly feel that explicit runtime handles make managed/native lifetimes safer and let two garbage collectors cooperate.

Summary angle: One central precision mechanical handle turns three difficult lifetime relationships into rules the garbage collector can track: type safety, pointer updates after object movement, and joint reachability across .NET and Java GC.
Narrative flow: layered reveal. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats.
Information blocks:
- A central handle connects three distinct orderly object blocks, labeled "类型安全".
- One managed object block shifts position while a thin pointer line updates to the new location, labeled "地址更新".
- Two small object groups on opposite sides share a bridge; one unreachable paired loop gently fades away, labeled "双 GC".

Main metaphor: a precision mechanical handle acting as both bridge and movable connector.
Subject: one metal mechanical handle hub at the center, clearly connecting managed objects, a native pointer slot, and a Java object group.
Composition/framing: centered main structure with three short readable paths extending sideways and into depth, generous negative space, wide cover illustration, aspect ratio 2.35:1.
Style/medium: combine abstract technical concept art with European clear-line comic style, precise outlines, flat readable colors, tidy environments, restrained humor and detail. Stylized, polished, editorial, and readable. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: deep ocean blue, warm orange, ivory white, graphite gray.
Visible text policy: render only these three short Chinese labels verbatim: "类型安全", "地址更新", "双 GC". No other text. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no chart axes, no architecture node names.
Constraints: one central primary handle only; no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: repeated primary handles, code rain, neon city, generic robot, dense HUD overlays.
